metrics.success_rate: Eventual HTTP 200s with a valid body / original requests x 100
metrics.goodput: Successful completions / wall-clock seconds (= throughput x success rate)
metrics.tts: Time to success: first attempt to final valid answer, including retries and pauses

validity_rule: A matched-pair run is discarded if k6 ran for more than 330 s (the laptop slept) or dropped iterations.

runs.label: Control: even split, no policies
runs.description: Equal weights across the three regions. No circuit breaker, no retry.

runs.label: Weighted 60/25/15, nothing else
runs.description: UK South takes 60% of the traffic, West Europe 25%, Sweden Central 15%. Still no breaker and no retry.

runs.label: Circuit breaker only
runs.description: Equal weights. A region leaves the pool after three failures inside 60 seconds, and a 429 counts as a failure. Nothing retries onto whoever is left.

runs.label: Gateway cap of 10 requests a minute
runs.description: The gateway refuses calls beyond 10 a minute, before Foundry sees them.

runs.label: Weights, breaker and a 500-a-minute cap
runs.description: Weights, a circuit breaker and a 500 requests-a-minute gateway cap, with no retry. Every call was refused in about 12 ms, too fast to have reached the model.

runs.label: Skewed 90/5/5 and breaker, no retry
runs.description: 90% of traffic lands on UK South, which runs out first and can trip the breaker. No retry.

runs.label: Breaker on server errors only, no retry
runs.description: The breaker ignores 429s and only trips on 5xx, so running out of quota never removes a region. No retry.

runs.label: Direct to Foundry, even split
runs.description: No gateway. The client splits calls evenly across the three regions and does not fall back. The matched pair for the control.

runs.label: Direct, 60/25/15, no fallback
runs.description: No gateway. The client picks a region at random (60/25/15) and does not fall back when that region is exhausted.

runs.label: Direct, walk the regions in order
runs.description: No gateway. The client tries UK South, then West Europe, then Sweden Central, moving on only after a failure. It made 567 HTTP calls to land 33 successes.

runs.label: Client retry, immediately
runs.description: The client retries a 429 straight away, up to three times, against an equal-weight pool with no breaker.

runs.label: Client retry, fixed 1 s pause
runs.description: The same client retry, with a fixed one second pause between attempts.

runs.label: Client retry, exponential backoff
runs.description: Client retry with exponential backoff: 500 ms, then 1 s, then 2 s.

runs.label: Client retry, backoff with jitter
runs.description: Backoff plus jitter, so the virtual users do not all wake up on the same tick.

runs.label: Client retry, wait for Retry-After
runs.description: The client sleeps for the Retry-After value Azure returns, usually the rest of the quota window.

runs.label: Client retry, wait for Retry-After (repeat)
runs.description: A repeat of the same setup, run again under another name.

runs.label: Breaker plus client Retry-After
runs.description: Skewed 90/5/5 weights and a breaker on 429 and 5xx, with the client sleeping for Retry-After.

runs.label: Even split, no breaker
runs.description: Equal weights and no breaker. A gateway retry rule was set but never worked, so this is the control again.

runs.label: Even split, no breaker (repeat)
runs.description: A repeat of the same configuration, run again under another name.

runs.label: Breaker on 429 and 5xx, even split (repeat)
runs.description: Equal weights and a breaker on 429 and 5xx: the same as the breaker-only run, run again. The gateway retry rule set here never worked.

runs.label: Breaker on 429 and 5xx, 90/5/5
runs.description: Skewed weights and a breaker on 429 and 5xx. UK South is expected to trip first.

runs.label: Breaker on 429 and 5xx, 90/5/5 (repeat)
runs.description: A repeat of the identical configuration, run again under another name. The two results differ.

runs.label: Skewed 90/5/5, no breaker
runs.description: Skewed weights with the breaker off.

runs.label: Breaker on 5xx only, 90/5/5
runs.description: Skewed weights, breaker on 5xx only. Running out of quota never trips the breaker.

runs.label: Breaker, 70/15/15
runs.description: A gentler skew than 90/5/5, with the breaker on 429 and 5xx.

runs.label: Breaker, 80/10/10
runs.description: An in-between skew: the spare regions get 10% each, with the breaker on 429 and 5xx.

runs.label: Breaker trips on first failure, 90/5/5
runs.description: 90/5/5 weights, with the breaker tripping on the first failure instead of the third.

runs.label: Even split, no breaker
runs.description: The even-split control with six times the quota. 200 requests fit inside one minute's quota. A gateway retry rule was set but never worked.

runs.label: Even split, no breaker (repeat)
runs.description: The same configuration again, run on its own later.

runs.label: Skewed 90/5/5, no breaker
runs.description: Skewed weights with the breaker off, at 60,000 TPM.
